productionSites.address: The Smoke House, 4420 West Lakeside Drive, Burbank, CA 91505

placement.reason: The final Argo screenplay names the Smoke House for Mendez and Chambers’s meeting. The restaurant’s official site publishes coordinates 34.1455689,-118.3413094 and links to its Google Maps venue pin 34.1455215,-118.341308. The official point sits on the restaurant footprint in aerial imagery, beside the golf course and across Lakeside Drive from Warner Bros.

story_time.basis: The screenplay dates the Burbank sequence to January 1980. The subsequent restaurant meeting precedes the January rescue; no specific meeting day is asserted.

placement.address: Wilcox Avenue at Hollywood Boulevard · Lipton’s
placement.reason: The film shows the Lipton’s sign over a Wilcox Avenue doorway beside the You Are the Star mural. The point follows that shown Hollywood entrance, checked against Seeing Stars’s matching Street View references. The dining room was filmed separately at the Smoke House in Burbank. The map does not place Lipton’s at the interior production address.

story_time.basis: The restaurant scene takes place at Christmas in the contemporary story. Release year 2016 is an editorial estimate; the year is not established on screen.

audit.verification: Canonical name is supported by the final screenplay’s named scene, not merely by a filming credit. Only Mendez and Chambers attend this restaurant meeting; Lester Siegel is introduced at his home afterward.
audit.time: January 1980 is supported by the screenplay chronology. Do not use the release year or label the scene 1979.

geocode.status: Superseded by official venue point; retained only as prior street-interpolation provenance.

audit.media: Argo wide frame and the Smoke House room photograph were visually compared. Photo capture date 2022-02-15 comes from nested EXIF DateTimeOriginal, not the Photoshop modification time in 2025.

pin_qa.visual_check: Both points fall on the restaurant parcel/roof beside Lakeside Golf Club and Warner Bros. on Esri imagery. The official point replaces the Census address point approximately 23 m northwest. A northern candidate near 34.152,-118.337 is unrelated to the restaurant.

audit.verification: Lipton’s is the on-screen name, visible in the selected frame. Bill is the manager, not evidence that the restaurant is named Bill’s. Hollywood is the exterior; the Smoke House is a separate interior component.

coordinate_provenance.precision: approximate facade position beside the matched Street View reference

audit.rejected_geocode: Census matched 1648 Wilcox Avenue at latitude34.096924, substantially south of the filmed doorway at Hollywood Boulevard. That match was not used. The building address 6436 Hollywood Boulevard and the matched entrance geometry anchor the entry.
audit.media: Actual exterior frame and modern exterior aerial visually verified. The 2024 Gb321 street photo was identified and dated from Commons metadata, but image retrieval returned403; no unverified current street image is substituted. The older 2017 street photo is retained only as a dated reference.
